description: Defines the interface for shared channel service and a mock implementation, including methods for notifications, sharing, and membership handling within the Mattermost platform.

classes.name: mockSharedChannelService
classes.description: A mock implementation of the SharedChannelServiceIFace for testing purposes.

methods.name: NotifyChannelChanged
methods.description: Records a notification that a channel has changed.

methods.name: NotifyUserProfileChanged
methods.description: Records a notification that a user profile has changed.

methods.name: Active
methods.description: Returns whether the service is active.

methods.name: SendChannelInvite
methods.description: Sends an invite to a channel, increments invitation count.

methods.name: NumInvitations
methods.description: Returns the number of invitations sent.

methods.name: HandleMembershipChange
methods.description: Handles membership changes in a channel (mock implementation).

methods.name: TransformMentionsOnReceiveForTesting
methods.description: Transforms mentions on message receive (mock implementation).
